deployments_detail.use: AI×SBDD drug discovery; proprietary "DS-GAI" generative AI (Azure OpenAI, Sep 2023); AI-agent drug discovery platform (2026 target)
deployments_detail.value: 400 hits identified from ~6bn compounds in 2 months

deployments_detail.use: Ultralarge-scale virtual screening for drug discovery on the Tokyo-1 GPU supercomputer, using NVIDIA BioNeMo and NVIDIA RAPIDS to accelerate large-scale data processing. Tokyo-1 (operated by Mitsui subsidiary Xeureka) is Japan's first generative-AI supercomputer for pharma. [NVIDIA (BioNeMo, RAPIDS, DGX H100); Xeureka/Mitsui (Tokyo-1 operator)]

AI-powered phenotypic screening: a deep-learning system that classifies morphological changes in cells that are undetectable by eyesight, used to evaluate the reactivity of cells to compounds in the company's library and prioritize drug-discovery projects. [none]

Smart Research Lab (SRL) in San Diego: automated experimentation platform integrating robotics, data systems, and software with generative-AI-powered design-make-test-analyze (DMTA) cycles to automate drug-discovery tasks and streamline candidate development. [none]

Strategic collaboration with Tempus AI to build multimodal AI models (Tempus PRISM2 foundation model integrating pathology imaging with clinical data) to optimize patient selection, biomarker discovery, and increase probability of clinical success across an antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) oncology program. [Tempus AI (PRISM2 foundation model)]

Strategic collaboration with BostonGene to integrate AI-driven multimodal analytics (AI foundation models plus digital-twin patient representations from genomic, transcriptomic, immune, and histopathologic data) into an ADC development program for patient selection, biomarker-based prioritization, and responder/non-responder identification. [BostonGene]

AI in clinical development: deterministic AI tools for patient recruitment and matching, plus generative AI (LLMs with strict guardrails) for patient-facing materials such as consent forms and study summaries, operated under a proactive compliance framework classifying AI systems as high-risk under the EU AI Act. [none]

DS-GAI (Daiichi Sankyo-Generative AI): in-house enterprise generative AI platform for brainstorming, writing/proofreading, English translation, document analysis, image generation, Python code execution, and internal-data analysis. Built on Azure OpenAI Service (with Azure AI Search) by partner Avanade Japan; developed in ~one month and in production since Sept 1, 2023. [Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service; Avanade (implementation partner)]
deployments_detail.value: Deployed to ~9,300 employees; >50% used it at least once, ~600 use it daily; >80% of surveyed users said it improved productivity/accuracy

deployments_detail.use: Commercial/customer-engagement AI and analytics at Daiichi Sankyo Europe using Veeva Link Key People (deep KOL data) plus Veeva Commercial Analytics Pulse data to identify new opportunities, gain a 360-degree view of customers, and predict customer needs; supported by an internal advanced-analytics/ML team building data products. [Veeva Systems (Link Key People, Commercial Analytics)]
